meta.name: Reinventing Elvis The 68 Comeback
meta.description: The making of Elvis Presley's famous live TV concert and the chaotic behind the scenes. It was the most-watched television event of the year with nearly half of the audience tuned in to watch Presley perform in his iconic black leather suit.
meta.slogan: One king of rock 'n' roll. One rebel director. Music's greatest second chance.
